newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks fall in morning after opening higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks fall in morning after opening higher.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were slightly down in early trade on Thursday after opening higher as some sectors such as precision instruments, steel and ship-building were supported by the yen's weakness against the dollar, brokers said.

Participants were cautious in trying the upside of the Nikkei average amid underlying worries that stocks might fall sharply after start of the new fiscal year in April due to the rise in the consumption tax, brokers said.
By 0025 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average had fallen 16.80 points or 0.09 percent to 18,455.65.
